data.title: The Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques Congratulates Amir of Kuwait on Successful Medical Examinations
data.content:
Riyadh, November 20, 2026, SPA -- Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud sent a cable of congratulations to Amir of the State of Kuwait Sheikh Meshal Al-Ahmad Al-Jaber Al-Sabah on his successful medical examinations.
    The Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques extended his heartfelt congratulations and best wishes to the amir, praying for his continued health and happiness.
    -- SPA
20:26 Local Time 17:26 GMT
